## Introduction

The project was inspired by a post by [**Karina Samsonova**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/karina-samsonova/) on linkedin.

The data is made available on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/vijayuv/onlineretail)

```{r}
#| label: import libraries
#| include: false
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r import_data}
df <- read.csv(unz("online_retail_data.zip", "OnlineRetail.csv"))
colnames(df)
dim(df)
dt <- setDT(df)   # convert data.frame to data.table (by reference)
dt[, sort(unique(Country))]
dt[, .N, by = Country][order(-N)]
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Filter UK, remove returns/negatives
uk <- dt[Country == "United Kingdom"]
uk <- uk[Quantity > 0 & !grepl("^C", InvoiceNo)]
uk[, InvoiceDate := as.POSIXct(InvoiceDate, format="%m/%d/%Y %H:%M", tz="UTC")]
uk[, TotalSales := Quantity * UnitPrice]
```

## Hourly Timing — Invoice vs Product

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Top 10 products
# Product-level hourly counts
product_time <- uk[, .(count = .N), by = .(hour = hour(InvoiceDate))]
product_time[, level := "Product-level"]

# Invoice-level hourly counts
invoice_dt <- uk[, .(invoice_time = min(InvoiceDate), invoice_revenue = sum(TotalSales)), by = InvoiceNo]
invoice_time <- invoice_dt[, .(count = .N), by = .(hour = hour(invoice_time))]
invoice_time[, level := "Invoice-level"]

timing_compare <- rbindlist(list(product_time, invoice_time))

p1 <- ggplot(timing_compare, aes(x = hour, y = count, color = level)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(title = "Customer Purchase Timing — Hourly",
       subtitle = "Invoice-level = customer decisions; Product-level = basket volume",
       x = "Hour of Day", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")

p1

```

```{r}
product_dow <- uk[, .(count = .N), by = .(weekday = weekdays(InvoiceDate))]
product_dow[, level := "Product-level"]
invoice_dow <- invoice_dt[, .(count = .N), by = .(weekday = weekdays(invoice_time))]
invoice_dow[, level := "Invoice-level"]
dow_compare <- rbindlist(list(product_dow, invoice_dow))
dow_compare[, weekday := factor(weekday, levels=c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"))]

p2 <- ggplot(dow_compare, aes(x = weekday, y = count, fill = level)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Purchasing Patterns by Day of Week",
       subtitle = "Invoice-level shows true customer decisions",
       x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")

p2

```

```{r}

product_dow <- uk[, .(count = .N), by = .(weekday = weekdays(InvoiceDate))]
product_dow[, level := "Product-level"]
invoice_dow <- invoice_dt[, .(count = .N), by = .(weekday = weekdays(invoice_time))]
invoice_dow[, level := "Invoice-level"]
dow_compare <- rbindlist(list(product_dow, invoice_dow))
dow_compare[, weekday := factor(weekday, levels=c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"))]

p2 <- ggplot(dow_compare, aes(x = weekday, y = count, fill = level)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Purchasing Patterns by Day of Week",
       subtitle = "Invoice-level shows true customer decisions",
       x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")

p2
```

```{r}
top_products_rev <- uk[, .(total_revenue = sum(TotalSales)), by = Description][order(-total_revenue)][1:5]
top_product_names <- top_products_rev$Description

product_time_rev <- uk[Description %in% top_product_names,
                       .(total_revenue = sum(TotalSales)),
                       by = .(hour = hour(InvoiceDate), Description)]

p3 <- ggplot(product_time_rev, aes(x = hour, y = total_revenue, color = Description)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Description, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Revenue-Weighted Hourly Patterns — Top 5 Products",
       x = "Hour of Day", y = "Revenue (£)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none")

p3

```

```{r}
dashboard <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "UK Online Retail Analysis — Customer & Product Timing",
    subtitle = "Invoice-level vs Product-level, Revenue-weighted Top Products, and Basket Size Bias",
    caption = "Data: Online Retail UK | Analysis: data.table + ggplot2",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
                  plot.caption = element_text(size=10, face="italic"))
  )

dashboard

```
